module: "Asset Browser" window of the world editor: browses the asset tree of the current level (level folder), the shared art/ and vehicles/, displays thumbnails, materials, meshes and texture sets, and lets you drag them into the scene. The selected object is stored in editor.selection["asset"] and displayed by the inspector (type "asset"). A modder mostly uses it through selectFileByPath / getAssetByPath to locate a file from another tool (e.g. the scene tree "Locate in Asset Browser" menu for TSStatics).
notes: The paths passed to selectFileByPath/getAssetByPath are virtual game paths starting with 'levels/...' (current level), or with the name of one of the loaded root folders (var.allDirs).

selectFileByPath does nothing if the root is not found; if the path does not contain the root prefix, string.match(path, rootPath.."(.+)") returns nil and the following string.match(filepath, ...) call would raise an error (no guard in the code).

onFileChanged only handles paths /levels/<current level>/... and /art/... once loading is finished (var.state == loading_done); files without an extension are ignored (treated as folders, TODO in the code).
Preferences are under 'assetBrowser.general.*' (thumbnailSize, skipImposters, fullPathSearch, instantiateMeshInFrontOfCamera, scrollSpeed, dragDropRotationMultiplier, etc.).

clearSelectedAsset.desc: Deselects the current asset: sets selectedInABView (and selected if the asset has a type) back to false, clears editor.selection["asset"] and forgets the corresponding selection history entry.

getAssetByPath.desc: Finds the asset of the loaded tree matching a virtual path (e.g. 'levels/<level>/art/shapes/x.dae'). Determines the root (level folder or root folder with the same name as the first segment), descends to the folder then looks for the file.

path.desc: Full virtual path of the file

returns.desc: Asset Browser asset entry, or nil if the root is not found (rest of the search: inferred from code)

getSelectedAsset.desc: Returns the asset currently selected in the Asset Browser (editor.selection["asset"]).

moveSelectionIndex.desc: Moves the selection index in the displayed list one step up or down (clamped between 1 and var.maxListIndexVal); used for keyboard navigation (AssetBrowser action map). No effect if there is no current index.

up.desc: true to go up (index - 1), false/nil to go down (index + 1)

onEditorActivated.desc: Hook called when the editor is activated. If the selected asset is a mesh or a material, refreshes the preview (meshPreview / matPreview).

onEditorGui.desc: Hook called every editor UI frame: draws the Asset Browser window, the image inspection window and the collection modal dialogs.

onEditorInitialized.desc: Hook called at editor initialization: registers the 'asset' inspector handler, the windows (assetBrowser, image inspector, collection dialogs), the assetBrowserEditMode edit mode, the Window > Asset Browser menu and the "Locate in Asset Browser" scene tree entry (valid for TSStatics).

onEditorPreferenceValueChanged.desc: Hook called when an editor preference changes; copies the 'assetBrowser.general.*' values (thumbnail size, filters, sorting, grouping, scroll speed, etc.) into the internal options.

onEditorRegisterPreferences.desc: Hook called to declare the Asset Browser preferences (category 'assetBrowser', subcategory 'general'): skipMainFolder, skipImposters, fullPathSearch, thumbnailSize, scrollSpeed, etc.

onEditorToolWindowGotFocus.desc: Hook called when a tool window gets focus; if it is the Asset Browser, pushes the 'AssetBrowser' action map.

onEditorToolWindowLostFocus.desc: Hook called when a tool window loses focus; if it is the Asset Browser, removes the 'AssetBrowser' action map.

onFileChanged.desc: Hook called when a file changes on disk. Once the tree is loaded, updates the relevant folder for files under /levels/<current level>/ or /art/: 'modified' adds/refreshes the asset (imposters, .cdae and .dae.png ignored), 'deleted' removes it.

selectFileByPath.desc: Public interface: opens the file's folder in the Asset Browser, selects the file and scrolls to it. Opens the window if it is not visible.

path.desc: Virtual path of the file, e.g. 'levels/<level>/art/shapes/x.dae'
